760020101.text: Hey, you, blondie! Perfect timing — this punk's cruisin' for a bruisin'. Lend a hand, and I'll make sure you get your cut.

760020102.text: #What are you playing at? Calling in backup cause you know you can't win? Fine, two can play at that game! Listen here, {M#mate}{F#lass}, help me take this guy down, and I'll split the Mora with you!

760020301.text: Huh... Let 'em bounce. Them water snakes don't know their place, tryna slither up on our turf.

760020302.text: Thanks for the help. Once my boys drop this "Mademoiselle Belleville" off in Nasha Town, you'll get your cut.

760020303.text: Oh, right, the payment— Wait... Mademoiselle? Are you human traffickers?!

760020304.text: Don't get the wrong idea, lil' girl. We don't touch kidnappings.

760020305.text: "Mademoiselle Belleville" is the name of this hunk of metal. Shipped all the way from the Fleuve Cendre, it wasn't easy getting it here. If it got snatched, we'd be ruined.

760020306.text: Ooh, a Fontainian clockwork meka? Wow, Fontaine tech really is something else. Imagine still working after being transported all this way...

760020307.text: Are you taking the Fonta? This thing's power system was ripped out ages ago. There's no way it's—

760020501.text: Ha! That's the end of that — foreign nutjob spouting nonsense, rambling on about liquidating my crew. Not doing much liquidating now he's frozen solid, 'ey?

760020502.text: Phew... Now we've saved Nasha Town from being flooded with contraband! Oh, and hey, don't forget our reward!

760020503.text: Hmph, don't get ahead of yourselves — I gotta check the goods first.

760020505.text: Of course! If something's wrong with the goods then we don't get nothin' — and your cut of nothin', is nothin'.

760020506.text: Tch... Look at these scratches. Rust, too! The Fleuve Cendre's getting real sloppy these days...

760020507.text: Huh? Isn't that a Fontainian clockwork meka? Wow, Fontaine tech really is something else. Imagine still working after being transported all this way...

760020705.text: Exactly! Why share it when we could totally keep it for oursel— wait, no! What are you saying!? We're righteous adventurers... right?

760020706.text: Though now we've sent them packing, Paimon's a little bit curious as to what exactly is in there that they were fighting for?

760020104.text: (Help Basu) You can't just go around taking people's stuff!

760020105.text: Haha, I knew you were a smart one. Let's trash these clowns!

760020107.text: Huh? Oh... right... yeah! That crate's totally packed with illegal contraband — we can't let them haul it to Nasha Town!

760020108.text: Treasure Hoarders, is it? No worries, I'll handle you all.

760020109.text: T—Too right! We're honorable adventurers, there's no way we're helping any nasty Treasure Hoarders! If someone's up to no good, we're gonna put a stop to them!

760029901.text: You crusty two-bit hustler! Tryin' to muscle in on our route? Mess up the Boss's shipment to Nasha Town, and you'll have to liquidate your whole crew just to cover what you owe!

760029902.text: Pfft, liquidate? I'll freeze your whole crew solid and then walk off with the goods!

760029903.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, it looks they're going to start a fight over there!

760029905.text: Ugh... Lousy luck today, but whatever – in this line of work, one more body ain't no trouble...

760029908.text: Ugh... At least that's finally over...

760029909.text: It doesn't look like we'll be getting a reward now... But hey, at least we shut it down when we did. If anyone had gotten hurt... Umm, it is shut down this time, right?
